message.content:
I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the current time in New York City, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock set to the “Eastern Time” zone, or use a command like:

```bash
date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" | TZ=America/New_York
```

That will give you the current local time in New York City.
